display_long_description:
# 💎The new GOLDMINER Update is HERE! ⛏️
Treasure-hunting miners have arrived in Ninja Warrior VR!

Grab the latest themed skin, Goldminer, and blast through the many courses of Ninja Warrior VR. With their functional strength and hardened physiques, reaching the finish line will be a breeze!

Enjoy all of the fun stages and gimmicks of Ninja Warrior VR!

[media]
# 🏃‍♂️ Push your limits with nothing but your own body! 🏃‍♀️
Run, climb, grab, swim, and leap through each challenge.
There are no tricks or shortcuts, only your determination.
Can you make it all the way to the end?
[media]
# 🔥 Conquer four legendary stages! 🔥
There's no time to waste in this test of true skill!
Challenge your strength, stamina, and skill on all three stages to make it to the Finals!
Clear them all and make your mark on the leaderboard for all to see! New stages will be added in future updates.
[media]

# 🎙️Let's play Ninja Warrior together! 🎙️
Race through courses with your friends, commentate from the announcer’s booth, swing swords, or bounce on trampolines.
Enjoy the wild, chaotic fun of Ninja Warrior with players from around the world.
